name: Mpox
value: 219 EU/EEA clade I cases in Oct (ECDC)
summary: Clade I mpox keeps spreading outside Africa, with 15 EU/EEA countries reporting cases in October; no new emergency
state: ECDC's update of 13 Nov says 15 EU/EEA countries reported 219 clade I mpox cases in October, Germany the most, and rates the risk to the general population as low (ECDC). UKHSA's overview of 12 Nov counts 298 confirmed UK clade Ib cases to 31 Oct (UKHSA). Searches on 24 Nov found no new emergency of international concern and no sharp acceleration, so continued clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is rated low. People with new or multiple sexual partners and travellers to affected countries are most exposed; UKHSA and NHS guidance sets out symptoms, testing and who is eligible for vaccination.
rubric_hit: Watch: clade I spreading outside Africa (219 EU/EEA cases in Oct); no PHEIC with accelerating growth

sources.title: UKHSA — Mpox outbreak: epidemiological overview, 12 November 2026

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
